authority: Central Insecticides Board & Registration Committee (CIBRC), Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
document_reference: List of Pesticides Banned for Manufacture, Import and Use in India

banned_pesticides.name: Endosulfan
banned_pesticides.notification: Supreme Court Order 2011 / Gazette of India
banned_pesticides.hazard_reason: High acute toxicity, endocrine disruption, bioaccumulation, severe teratogenic risks.

banned_pesticides.name: Monocrotophos
banned_pesticides.hazard_reason: Extreme organophosphate neurotoxicity, dangerous to humans, birds, and aquatic life.

banned_pesticides.name: Paraquat Dichloride
banned_pesticides.status: Severely Restricted / Banned in Multiple States
banned_pesticides.hazard_reason: No antidote exists; fatal upon accidental ingestion or dermal absorption.

banned_pesticides.name: Methyl Parathion
banned_pesticides.hazard_reason: WHO Class Ia extremely hazardous chemical.

banned_pesticides.name: DDT
banned_pesticides.hazard_reason: Persistent organic pollutant causing eggshell thinning and bioaccumulation.
